resources.string: Sends your Health Connect data (activity, heart, sleep, workouts, cycle…) to your BodyLens server every hour.
Health Connect is not available on this phone. Install or update it from Google Play.
Open Health Connect in Google Play
Copy it in BodyLens → Your account → Data sources → Apple Health / Health Connect. It contains a secret key: do not share it.
Allow \"read data in the background\" too, so the hourly sending works with the app closed.
